scope_statement: Do not count Copilot-marked squash dbe1d131 as AI_INCOMPLETE_REMEDIATION of GHSA-2MHJ-FHVG-V428. Independently resolved parent is 4b85df49. The GHSA-named residual is ClassDefinition UID/name preg_match with a leading ^ and no trailing $. That exact hunk is first authored by unmarked human PR 19145 member e9663121 (subject draft; author and committer Ji Jia Jia / kingjia90; no Co-authored-by). ClassDefinition.php blob b954e136 is identical from that human member through the squash. All four copilot-swe-agent members edit only Dao.php or LocateFileTrait.php. Assigning the squash Copilot trailer to the regex hunk transfers authorship across commits. Closer 33a0e188 does add the missing end anchor on the same regex and is an ancestor of public tags v12.3.9 and v2026.1.5; those release facts do not convert the human regex rewrite into an AI hunk.
ai_marker_evidence: Squash dbe1d131 is single-parent 4b85df49, GitHub squash of PR 19145, subject [Security]: Enhance Class Definition security (#19145). Body has Co-authored-by: copilot-swe-agent[bot] <198982749+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com> plus Agent-Logs-Url lines that belong to later members. GitHub author_login of the squash is kingjia90; committer is web-flow. PR 19145 members: three unmarked human drafts by kingjia90, then four copilot-swe-agent[bot] commits. The regex hunk is only in the first human draft. Copilot members have Agent-Logs-Url and never touch ClassDefinition.php.

first_vulnerable_2026_1.note: v2026.1.0 through v2026.1.3 peel without dbe1d131 and still have parent blob b09f5e65 (unanchored regex). They are in the global GHSA 2026.1 range but are not cuts of the incomplete ^ residual.

attacks.1_older_hole_not_residual_of_attempted_b: does_not_kill: parent 4b85df49 / tags v12.3.7 and v2026.1.3 blob b09f5e65 already had unanchored /[a-zA-Z]\w+/ and /[a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)?/ guards. The hypothesized attempt added only a leading ^. The first-party GHSA names that omitted $ as the residual of commit dbe1d131e4. That residual-of-attempt story would survive if the hunk were AI-authored. It is not.
attacks.2_regex_hunk_human_or_ai_marked_merge_on: fatal: PR 19145 member e9663121 (Ji Jia Jia, subject draft, no AI marker) is the only member that diffs ClassDefinition.php. Copilot members b780ab67, 95e8021f, a4ca8d91, c518a75c do not touch that file. Squash dbe1d131 inherits Copilot co-author from those later members. Blame at v12.3.8 of the two regex lines is the squash SHA because GitHub squash collapsed members. That is authorship transfer, not an AI hunk.
attacks.3_parent_already_equivalent_validation: does_not_kill: parent lacks the leading ^. but_for still FAIL because Copilot-authored members do not own the regex residual; reverting only Copilot Dao/LocateFile edits leaves blob b954e136 in place.
attacks.4_fix_not_same_mechanism_or_not_descenda: does_not_kill: 33a0e188 is a descendant of dbe1d131 (7 commits). First-parent ClassDefinition.php blob at the fix parent equals the squash blob. The fix first-parent adds trailing $ / rewrites the id pattern to ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$. GHSA references this commit. Extra Block.php quoting is a sibling sink the candidate never touched; it does not stop the regex amendment from being same-mechanism. PR 19177 member ae7b6958 (human) authors that regex $; Copilot Autofix later tweaks the id character class. Fix authorship is irrelevant once candidate AI hunk already failed.
attacks.5_tags_wrong_branch_draft_or_out_of_rang: does_not_kill_containment: lightweight tags v12.3.8 and v2026.1.4 are public GitHub Releases (draft=false, prerelease=false). Packagist pimcore/pimcore source.reference equals peeled SHAs. v12.3.8 is an ancestor of v2026.1.4; v2026.1.4 second parent is v12.3.8. v2026.1.5 second parent is v12.3.9. Repo advisory lists only <=2026.1.4 / 2026.1.5; global GHSA also lists <12.3.9 / 12.3.9. Both lines contain the incomplete regex then the closer. Citing v2026.1.0 as first vulnerable for this residual would be false (no candidate; parent blob).
attacks.6_uniqueness_already_counted: does_not_kill: absent from canonical81 81 ids, fp211 public_cases, fp211 ledger, publication_adjudications, final_mechanisms. fresh-nz REJECT (Copilot closer 33a0e188 treated as origin and delegated) and batch27 BLOCKED (zero tags) are uncounted hypotheses, not admissions. Same GHSA is not a second counted case.
attacks.7_identity_package_repo_wrong: does_not_kill: global GHSA type=reviewed, withdrawn_at=null, source_code_location=https://github.com/pimcore/pimcore, composer package pimcore/pimcore, alias CVE-2026-55072. Repo advisory state=published, same ghsa_id. Not withdrawn, not cross-bound.

counterevidence: Hypothesis treated squash dbe1d131 as an explicit Copilot attempt that added ^ and omitted $. PR member replay shows the ^ addition is unmarked human e9663121. Copilot never edited ClassDefinition.php.

Contract ai_hunk_gate requires an atomic AI-marked commit that authors the relevant vulnerable hunk. PR branding and squash-carrier trailers are insufficient. topology_gate forbids transferring authorship across squash members.

Copilot SWE-agent work in the same PR is Dao.php quoteIdentifier and LocateFileTrait path checks. The GHSA also names unquoted Block.php table concatenation as a sink Dao.php quoting did not cover. That is an untouched sibling path and is not incomplete-remediation causality for the regex residual.

Closer 33a0e188 is itself Copilot Autofix co-authored on the landing squash. That marker is on the reversal, not on the incomplete regex attempt. fresh-nz correctly refused to treat 33a0e188 as origin.
batch27 BLOCKED on a tagless clone. This clone fetched 346 tags independently. Release containment of the human incomplete regex is proved and still does not admit AI causality.

User policy: incomplete remediation counts only if the AI commit explicitly attempted this same boundary, that attempt was publicly released, the GHSA describes the exact residual, and the later patch closes it. The GHSA and later patch match the residual; the AI commit did not attempt that regex boundary.
